positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Brain, Responsible AI and Human-Centered Technology

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded company.  Worked with school districts to develop web-based software for teachers to track student data and analyze progress through particular graphs and reports.

positions.title: Behavior Analyst (BCBA), Software Developer
positions.description: Developed internal website and tools for scheduling, billing and data collection.  Supervised home-based behavioral services for children with disabilities.  Conducted assessments, wrote behavior plans, developed training programs for direct care staff and families.

positions.title: Special Education Teacher
positions.description: Taught 2nd and 3rd grade special education classroom for students with emotional and behavioral challenges.  Developed behavior support plans, wrote IEPs, progress reports and lesson plans.  Supervised and trained two paraprofessionals.

positions.title: Lead Teacher and Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Taught classroom of nine high-functioning students ages 11-21 with PDD diagnosis or brain injury.  Students exhibited severe challenging behaviors, and academic skills at or near grade level.  Supervised five staff in behavior management, teaching and curriculum design.

Developed system to track and display behavioral data integrated into Excel and Word.  Supervised training of over 100 users.  Wrote interactive multimedia programs for student lessons and curriculum tools for teachers.
